title: feishin values
description: Configurable Helm values for the feishin chart.

replicaCount.description: Number of application pod replicas to run. Increase for horizontally scalable services when storage and application behavior allow multiple pods.

image.description: Container image settings for the main application container.

repository.description: Container image repository used for the main application container.

pullPolicy.description: Kubernetes image pull policy for the container.

imagePullSecrets.description: Optional list of image pull secrets used when the container image is stored in a private registry.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name portion used when generating Kubernetes resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full generated Kubernetes resource name.

podAnnotations.description: Additional annotations applied to application pods.

podLabels.description: Additional labels applied to application pods.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context applied to all containers in the pod.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the main application container.

env.description: Feishin server preconfiguration and runtime environment variables.

SERVER_LOCK.description: When true and server settings are configured, only username and password can be changed.

SERVER_TYPE.description: Preconfigured server type. Supported values are jellyfin, navidrome, and subsonic.

REMOTE_URL.description: Optional external URL for compatibility with sharing features.

LEGACY_AUTHENTICATION.description: Legacy auth flag used when SERVER_LOCK is enabled.

ANALYTICS_DISABLED.description: Set to true to disable Umami analytics tracking.

PUBLIC_PATH.description: Public path served by the nginx container.

FS_GENERAL_ACCENT.description: general.accent: CSS rgb(r, g, b) string (e.g. rgb(53, 116, 252)). Invalid values are ignored. Upstream default when unset: rgb(53, 116, 252).

FS_GENERAL_ALBUM_BACKGROUND.description: general.albumBackground: true / false — Show album background image. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_ALBUM_BACKGROUND_BLUR.description: general.albumBackgroundBlur: Blur amount for album background (number). Upstream default when unset: 3.

FS_GENERAL_ARTIST_BACKGROUND.description: general.artistBackground: true / false — Show artist background image. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_ARTIST_BACKGROUND_BLUR.description: general.artistBackgroundBlur: Blur amount for artist background (number). Upstream default when unset: 3.

FS_GENERAL_BLUR_EXPLICIT_IMAGES.description: general.blurExplicitImages: true / false — Blur explicit images. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_COMBINED_LYRICS_AND_VISUALIZE.description: general.combinedLyricsAndVisualizer: true / false — Combine lyrics and visualizer panel. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_ENABLE_GRID_MULTI_SELECT.description: general.enableGridMultiSelect: true / false — Enable multi-select in grid views. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_EXTERNAL_LINKS.description: general.externalLinks: true / false — Show external links in UI. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_FOLLOW_CURRENT_SONG.description: general.followCurrentSong: true / false — Follow current song in list. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_FOLLOW_SYSTEM_THEME.description: general.followSystemTheme: true / false — Use OS light/dark preference. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_HOME_FEATURE.description: general.homeFeature: true / false — Show home featured carousel. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_HOME_FEATURE_STYLE.description: general.homeFeatureStyle: multiple / single - Home featured carousel style. Upstream default when unset: single.

FS_GENERAL_IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_PRIORITY.description: general.imagePlaceholderPriority: thumbhash / blurhash / dominantColor / off - Which image placeholder shows first while art loads; off disables placeholders. Upstream default when unset: thumbhash.

FS_GENERAL_LANGUAGE.description: general.language: UI language code (e.g. en, de, fr). Upstream default when unset: en.

FS_GENERAL_THEME.description: general.theme: One of: ayuDark, ayuLight, catppuccinLatte, catppuccinMocha, defaultDark, defaultLight, dracula, githubDark, githubLight, glassyDark, gruvboxDark, gruvboxLight, highContrastDark, highContrastLight, materialDark, materialLight, monokai, nightOwl, nord, oneDark, rosePine, rosePineDawn, rosePineMoon, shadesOfPurple, solarizedDark, solarizedLight, tokyoNight, vscodeDarkPlus, vscodeLightPlus. Upstream default when unset: defaultDark.

FS_GENERAL_THEME_DARK.description: general.themeDark: Same as theme (used when system is dark). Upstream default when unset: defaultDark.

FS_GENERAL_THEME_LIGHT.description: general.themeLight: Same as theme (used when system is light). Upstream default when unset: defaultLight.

FS_GENERAL_LASTFM_API_KEY.description: general.lastfmApiKey: Last.fm API key. Upstream default when unset: *(empty)*.

FS_GENERAL_LAST_FM.description: general.lastFM: true / false — Enable Last.fm. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_LISTEN_BRAINZ.description: general.listenBrainz: true / false — ListenBrainz links. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_MUSIC_BRAINZ.description: general.musicBrainz: true / false — MusicBrainz links. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_NATIVE_ASPECT_RATIO.description: general.nativeAspectRatio: true / false — Use native cover art aspect ratio. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_PATH_REPLACE.description: general.pathReplace: Path pattern to replace (e.g. server path in Docker). Upstream default when unset: *(empty)*.

FS_GENERAL_PATH_REPLACE_WITH.description: general.pathReplaceWith: Replacement path. Upstream default when unset: *(empty)*.

FS_GENERAL_PLAYERBAR_OPEN_DRAWER.description: general.playerbarOpenDrawer: true / false — Open queue/lyrics as drawer from player bar. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_PRIMARY_SHADE.description: general.primaryShade: Mantine primary shade 0–9 (number). Upstream default when unset: 6.

FS_GENERAL_QOBUZ.description: general.qobuz: true / false — Qobuz links. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_RESUME.description: general.resume: true / false — Resume playback on load. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_SHOW_LYRICS_IN_SIDEBAR.description: general.showLyricsInSidebar: true / false — Show lyrics in sidebar. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_SHOW_RATINGS.description: general.showRatings: true / false — Show star ratings. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_SHOW_VISUALIZER_IN_SIDEBAR.description: general.showVisualizerInSidebar: true / false — Show visualizer in sidebar. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED_NAVIGATION.description: general.sidebarCollapsedNavigation: true / false — Start with collapsed sidebar nav. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSE_SHARED.description: general.sidebarCollapseShared: true / false — Share sidebar collapse state. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_IMAGE_EXPAND.description: general.sidebarImageExpand: true / false — Show the player-bar album-art button that expands art into the sidebar. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_PLAYLIST_FOLDERS.description: general.sidebarPlaylistFolders: true / false — Group playlists into folders by name separator. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_PLAYLIST_FOLDER_SEPAR.description: general.sidebarPlaylistFolderSeparator: Character or string that separates folder levels in a playlist name. Empty = use default. Upstream default when unset: /.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_PLAYLIST_FOLDER_TREE_.description: general.sidebarPlaylistFolderTreeIndent: Pixels each tree level is indented (0–64). Upstream default when unset: 16.
general.sidebarPlaylistFolderTreeLineColor: CSS color for tree connecting lines. Empty = theme default. Upstream default when unset: *(empty)*.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_PLAYLIST_FOLDER_VIEW.description: general.sidebarPlaylistFolderView: single / tree / navigation — How folders are displayed in the sidebar. Upstream default when unset: tree.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_PLAYLIST_LIST.description: general.sidebarPlaylistList: true / false — Show playlist list in sidebar. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_PLAYLIST_MODE.description: general.sidebarPlaylistMode: compact / expanded — Sidebar playlist row layout. Upstream default when unset: expanded.

FS_GENERAL_SIDEBAR_PLAYLIST_SORTING.description: general.sidebarPlaylistSorting: true / false — Enable playlist sorting in sidebar. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_SIDE_QUEUE_TYPE.description: general.sideQueueType: sideDrawerQueue / sideQueue — Side play queue style. Upstream default when unset: sideQueue.

FS_GENERAL_SIDE_QUEUE_LAYOUT.description: general.sideQueueLayout: horizontal / vertical — Attached side queue layout orientation. Upstream default when unset: horizontal.

FS_GENERAL_USE_THEME_ACCENT_COLOR.description: general.useThemeAccentColor: true / false — Use theme’s accent color instead of custom. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_GENERAL_USE_THEME_PRIMARY_SHADE.description: general.useThemePrimaryShade: true / false — Use theme’s primary shade. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_GENERAL_ZOOM_FACTOR.description: general.zoomFactor: UI zoom percentage (number). Upstream default when unset: 100.

FS_PLAYBACK_MEDIA_SESSION.description: playback.mediaSession: true / false — Media Session API (e.g. browser/media keys). Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_PLAYBACK_WEB_AUDIO.description: playback.webAudio: true / false — Use Web Audio for playback. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_PLAYBACK_AUDIO_FADE_ON_STATUS_CHANGE.description: playback.audioFadeOnStatusChange: true / false — Fade on play/pause. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_PLAYBACK_PRESERVE_PITCH.description: playback.preservePitch: true / false — Preserve pitch when changing speed. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_PLAYBACK_SCROBBLE_ENABLED.description: playback.scrobble.enabled: true / false — Enable scrobbling. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_PLAYBACK_SCROBBLE_NOTIFY.description: playback.scrobble.notify: true / false — Scrobble notifications. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_PLAYBACK_SCROBBLE_AT_DURATION.description: playback.scrobble.scrobbleAtDuration: Seconds of playback before scrobble. Upstream default when unset: 240.

FS_PLAYBACK_SCROBBLE_AT_PERCENTAGE.description: playback.scrobble.scrobbleAtPercentage: Percentage of track before scrobble. Upstream default when unset: 75.

FS_PLAYBACK_TRANSCODE_ENABLED.description: playback.transcode.enabled: true / false — Enable transcoding. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_PLAYBACK_TRANSCODE_FORMAT.description: playback.transcode.format: Transcode format string (codec/container), e.g. server-specific value. Empty = use default. Upstream default when unset: *(unset)*.

FS_PLAYBACK_TRANSCODE_BITRATE.description: playback.transcode.bitrate: Transcode bitrate (number, kbps or as defined by server). Upstream default when unset: *(unset)*.

FS_PLAYBACK_FILTERS.description: playback.filters: JSON array of player filters: each object needs id, field, operator, value; optional isEnabled. Invalid JSON or shape is ignored. Upstream default when unset: [].

FS_DISCORD_ENABLED.description: discord.enabled: true / false — Discord rich presence. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: discord.clientId: Custom Discord application ID. Upstream default when unset: *(built-in)*.

FS_DISCORD_DISPLAY_TYPE.description: discord.displayType: artist / feishin / song. Upstream default when unset: feishin.

FS_DISCORD_LINK_TYPE.description: discord.linkType: last_fm / musicbrainz / musicbrainz_last_fm / none. Upstream default when unset: none.

FS_DISCORD_SHOW_AS_LISTENING.description: discord.showAsListening: true / false. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_DISCORD_SHOW_PAUSED.description: discord.showPaused: true / false — Show paused state. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_DISCORD_SHOW_SERVER_IMAGE.description: discord.showServerImage: true / false. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_DISCORD_SHOW_STATE_ICON.description: discord.showStateIcon: true / false. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_LYRICS_FETCH.description: lyrics.fetch: true / false — Fetch lyrics. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_LYRICS_FOLLOW.description: lyrics.follow: true / false — Follow current line. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_LYRICS_DELAY_MS.description: lyrics.delayMs: Sync delay in milliseconds. Upstream default when unset: 0.

FS_LYRICS_LINE_LEAD_TIME_MS.description: lyrics.lineLeadTimeMs: Milliseconds before a line becomes active while following. Upstream default when unset: 800.

FS_LYRICS_FOLLOW_SCROLL_ALIGNMENT.description: lyrics.followScrollAlignment: Vertical follow position. 0 centers the active line; negative moves it higher, positive moves it lower (-50 to 50). Upstream default when unset: 0.

FS_LYRICS_PREFER_LOCAL.description: lyrics.preferLocalLyrics: true / false — Prefer local lyric files. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_LYRICS_SHOW_MATCH.description: lyrics.showMatch: true / false. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_LYRICS_SHOW_PROVIDER.description: lyrics.showProvider: true / false. Upstream default when unset: true.

FS_LYRICS_ENABLE_AUTO_TRANSLATION.description: lyrics.enableAutoTranslation: true / false. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_LYRICS_TRANSLATION_API_KEY.description: lyrics.translationApiKey: API key for lyric translation. Upstream default when unset: *(empty)*.

FS_LYRICS_TRANSLATION_TARGET_LANGUAGE.description: lyrics.translationTargetLanguage: Target language code. Upstream default when unset: en.

FS_LYRICS_ALIGNMENT.description: lyrics.alignment: center / left / right. Upstream default when unset: center.

FS_LYRICS_PADDING_LEFT.description: lyricsDisplay.default.paddingLeft: Left content padding as a percentage (0–20). Upstream default when unset: 0.

FS_LYRICS_PADDING_RIGHT.description: lyricsDisplay.default.paddingRight: Right content padding as a percentage (0–20). Upstream default when unset: 0.

FS_AUTO_DJ_ALBUM_STRATEGY.description: autoDJ.albumStrategy: similar / library_random. Upstream default when unset: similar.

FS_AUTO_DJ_ALLOW_DUPLICATES.description: autoDJ.allowDuplicates: true / false — Allow songs or albums already in the queue to be added again. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_AUTO_DJ_ENABLED.description: autoDJ.enabled: true / false. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_AUTO_DJ_ITEM_COUNT.description: autoDJ.itemCount: Number of items to add. Upstream default when unset: 5.

FS_AUTO_DJ_MODE.description: autoDJ.mode: songs / albums. Upstream default when unset: songs.

FS_AUTO_DJ_ONLY_SIMILAR.description: autoDJ.onlySimilar: true / false — Treat item count as a maximum; use the first non-empty source (similar, then genre, artist, or random) and do not fill from later sources. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_AUTO_DJ_SONG_STRATEGY.description: autoDJ.songStrategy: similar / library_random. Upstream default when unset: similar.

FS_AUTO_DJ_TIMING.description: autoDJ.timing: Timing value (number). Upstream default when unset: 1.

FS_CSS_CONTENT.description: css.content: Custom CSS string (sanitized like in-app custom CSS). Set FS_CSS_ENABLED=true to apply. Upstream default when unset: *(empty)*.

FS_CSS_ENABLED.description: css.enabled: true / false — Enable custom CSS. Upstream default when unset: false.

FS_FONT_TYPE.description: font.type: builtIn / system / custom. Upstream default when unset: builtIn.

FS_FONT_BUILT_IN.description: font.builtIn: Built-in font name. Upstream default when unset: Inter.

FS_FONT_SYSTEM.description: font.system: System font name (when type is system). Upstream default when unset: *(empty)*.

service.description: Kubernetes Service configuration for exposing the application inside the cluster.

type.description: Kubernetes Service type, such as ClusterIP, NodePort, or LoadBalancer.

port.description: Service port exposed inside the cluster.

targetPort.description: Container port or named port that receives traffic from the Service.

portName.description: Name assigned to the Service port and matching container port where applicable.

ingress.description: Kubernetes Ingress configuration for exposing the application through an ingress controller.

enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource.

className.description: IngressClass name used by the target ingress controller.

annotations.description: Additional annotations applied to the Ingress resource.

hosts.description: Ingress host and path rules routed to the chart Service.

tls.description: TLS configuration for Ingress hosts and referenced certificate secrets.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits for the main application container.

livenessProbe.description: Kubernetes liveness probe used to restart the container when it becomes unhealthy.

readinessProbe.description: Kubernetes readiness probe used to decide when the pod can receive traffic.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector constraints for scheduling pods onto matching nodes.

tolerations.description: Pod tolerations that allow scheduling onto tainted nodes.

affinity.description: Pod affinity and anti-affinity rules for advanced scheduling control.

httpRoutes.description: Named HTTPRoutes with independent Gateway references, hostname lists, annotations and rules.

parentRefs.description: Gateway and optional listener attachments for this route.

hostnames.description: Explicit hostnames served by this route.

rules.description: Gateway API rules and filters; backendRefs are supplied by the chart. Defaults to PathPrefix /.
